def fd = [ 'equityAndLiabilities': [ 'shareholdersFunds': [ ['name': 'Share Capital', 'note': '1', 'currentYear': 5000000, 'previousYear': 5000000], ['name': 'Reserves and Surplus', 'note': '2', 'currentYear': 2450000, 'previousYear': 1800000] ], 'nonCurrentLiabilities': [ ['name': 'Long-Term Borrowings', 'note': '3', 'currentYear': 1200000, 'previousYear': 1500000], ['name': 'Deferred Tax Liabilities (Net)', 'note': '4', 'currentYear': 45000, 'previousYear': 40000] ], 'currentLiabilities': [ ['name': 'Short-Term Borrowings', 'note': '', 'currentYear': 0, 'previousYear': 0], ['name': 'Trade Payables (MSME)', 'note': '5', 'currentYear': 120000, 'previousYear': 80000], ['name': 'Trade Payables (Others)', 'note': '5', 'currentYear': 850000, 'previousYear': 720000], ['name': 'Other Current Liabilities', 'note': '6', 'currentYear': 320000, 'previousYear': 290000], ['name': 'Short-Term Provisions', 'note': '7', 'currentYear': 150000, 'previousYear': 130000] ] ], 'assets': [ 'nonCurrentAssets': [ ['name': 'Property, Plant and Equipment', 'note': '8', 'currentYear': 4500000, 'previousYear': 4800000], ['name': 'Intangible Assets', 'note': '8', 'currentYear': 300000, 'previousYear': 350000], ['name': 'Non-Current Investments', 'note': '9', 'currentYear': 1500000, 'previousYear': 1000000] ], 'currentAssets': [ ['name': 'Inventories', 'note': '10', 'currentYear': 980000, 'previousYear': 1100000], ['name': 'Trade Receivables', 'note': '11', 'currentYear': 1250000, 'previousYear': 1050000], ['name': 'Cash and Cash Equivalents', 'note': '12', 'currentYear': 1485000, 'previousYear': 1160000], ['name': 'Short-Term Loans and Advances', 'note': '13', 'currentYear': 120000, 'previousYear': 100000] ] ] ]
StringBuilder csv = new StringBuilder() csv.append("Schedule III Financials - Zenith Innovations Pvt Ltd
") csv.append("Balance Sheet as at: 31 March, 2026

") csv.append("Category,Particulars,Note No.,Current Year (${currSymbol}),Previous Year (${currSymbol})
")
def addSection = { category, rows -> for (row in rows) { csv.append(""").append(category).append("",") csv.append(""").append(row.name).append("",") csv.append(""").append(row.note ?: '').append("",") csv.append(row.currentYear).append(",") csv.append(row.previousYear).append("
") } }
csv.append("I. EQUITY AND LIABILITIES,,,,
") addSection("Shareholders' Funds", fd.equityAndLiabilities.shareholdersFunds) addSection("Non-Current Liabilities", fd.equityAndLiabilities.nonCurrentLiabilities) addSection("Current Liabilities", fd.equityAndLiabilities.currentLiabilities)
def totalEqLiabCY = 5000000 + 2450000 + 1200000 + 45000 + 120000 + 850000 + 320000 + 150000 def totalEqLiabPY = 5000000 + 1800000 + 1500000 + 40000 + 80000 + 720000 + 290000 + 130000 csv.append(""TOTAL EQUITY AND LIABILITIES",,,${totalEqLiabCY},${totalEqLiabPY}

")
csv.append("II. ASSETS,,,,
") addSection("Non-Current Assets", fd.assets.nonCurrentAssets) addSection("Current Assets", fd.assets.currentAssets)
def totalAssetsCY = 4500000 + 300000 + 1500000 + 980000 + 1250000 + 1485000 + 120000 def totalAssetsPY = 4800000 + 350000 + 1000000 + 1100000 + 1050000 + 1160000 + 100000 csv.append(""TOTAL ASSETS",,,${totalAssetsCY},${totalAssetsPY}
")
ec.web.response.setContentType("text/csv; charset=utf-8") ec.web.response.setHeader("Content-Disposition", "attachment; filename="Schedule_III_Financials.csv"") ec.web.response.writer.write('﻿') // UTF-8 BOM ec.web.response.writer.write(csv.toString()) ec.web.response.writer.flush()
